id, template_id AS templateId, version, content, remark, editor_id AS editorId, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_template (id, skin, file_path, update_time, editor_id) values (#{id}, #{skin}, #{filePath}, now(), #{editorId})
mapper.update: update fly_template set update_time = now(), editor_id = #{editorId} where skin = #{skin} and file_path = #{filePath}
mapper.delete: delete from fly_template where skin = #{skin} and file_path = #{filePath}
mapper.select: select from fly_template where skin = #{skin} and file_path = #{filePath} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fly_template_version (id, template_id, version, content, remark, editor_id, create_time) values (#{id}, #{templateId}, #{version}, #{content}, #{remark}, #{editorId}, now())
mapper.select: select from fly_template_version where template_id = #{templateId} and version = #{version} limit 1
